title: Claude Code
subtitle: Create, attach to and govern Claude Code sessions — no SSH. Every launch is policed; every session is observable.

transport.streamJsonHint: Bidirectional NDJSON bridged and governed in full by Olivares.
transport.remoteControlHint: Lifecycle only — I/O is relayed to Anthropic’s cloud, so it cannot be shown here.

badge.governedHint: Tool-calls are policed in line by the governed PEP.
badge.denyClosedHint: No PEP provisioned — every tool-call is denied (the session can think, not act).
badge.recordingHint: Bridged I/O anchored as signed ledger evidence.
badge.criticalHint: Privileged launch — required human approval and mandatory recording.

create.title: New Claude Code session
create.description: Olivares launches and governs the process — the visual equivalent of the CLI launch, with policy in line.
create.name: Name
create.isolationNativeOnly: Only native is wired this release; container/sandbox are refused.
create.envAllowHint: Allowlist of host env var NAMES to pass through (values are never sent).
create.criticalWarning: This is a privileged launch (it removes the per-tool prompt). It requires a two-person approval and is recorded — it may stay pending until approved.
create.classifiedWarning: A read-write mount of a classified workspace is a privileged launch (approval + recording).
create.templateHint: The engine merges the template's terms over the fields above before the launch gates, and writes them into the session's own process — so the restriction holds for a caller that never opens this console.
create.templateUnenforceable: This template declares terms this launch cannot enforce, so the launch is refused rather than started without them:
create.templateOverrides_one: The template overrides {{count}} of your choices:
create.templateOverrides_other: The template overrides {{count}} of your choices:
create.profileHint: Select the provider profile for this session. A profile is required. Local requirements are checked for the current selection after the template preview.
create.profilesNotRead: Provider profiles could not be read; the launch can still go ahead without one.
create.profileEnvConflict: HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME and GROK_HOME belong to the profile: a launch that forwards any of them is refused here. Other names are still subject to the server's own validation.

detail.minimalData: Minimal-data: no secrets, tokens, env values, prompts or transcripts are stored — only references and flags.

info.workspaceDirectoryOwn: its own directory for this session

live.inputPlaceholder: Send an NDJSON line to stdin…
live.advancedHint: Send one NDJSON line to stdin. The sentence field is the default.
live.lag: {{count}} frame(s) dropped (buffer overflow) — output below resumes after the gap.
live.remoteControl: This is a remote-control session: its I/O is relayed to Anthropic’s cloud and is not bridged here. Olivares manages the lifecycle only.
live.notLive: This session is not live (it is {{state}}). Resume it to attach to its I/O.
live.ioUnavailableNotLiveOnNode: No bridged I/O on this node.
live.ioUnavailableRemoteControl: This session's I/O is not bridged here (remote-control).
live.inputNotAllowed: Input is only accepted while the session is running.
live.interruptHint: Cancel the active turn and keep this session open.
live.interrupted: Turn interrupted. The session remains open.
live.interruptFenceUnavailable: Refresh the run to obtain its current work generation before interrupting.
live.interruptUnknown: The interruption outcome is unknown. Check the session before trying again.
live.interruptWorkConflict: The session cannot accept this interruption in its current work state. Refresh the run to check its status.

gov.title: Governance posture
gov.subtitle: What governs this session right now.
gov.pepProvisioned: Governed — every tool-call is policed in line
gov.pepDenyClosed: Deny-closed — no PEP provisioned, so every tool-call is denied
gov.pepRemote: Not bridged — remote-control I/O is governed by Anthropic
gov.budgetHint: Per-inference budget is enforced at the gateway.
gov.recordingOn: On — bridged I/O anchored as signed ledger evidence
gov.recordingOff: Lifecycle only — full I/O recording not enabled for this session
gov.noPermission: You don’t have permission to view this signal.

events.title: Lifecycle ledger
events.subtitle: Each transition is anchored by PayloadHash to the signed audit ledger.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: Host directories a session works in — mounted, jailed and DLP-classified.

empty.title: No workspaces registered
empty.description: Register a host directory to give sessions a governed working tree and a file browser.

create.title: Register a workspace
create.description: Register a host directory root. The file API jails every access to this root — symlink escapes and ".." are refused, never clamped.
create.name: Name
create.rootPathHint: Absolute, canonical host path. Resolved at registration.
create.allowSubpathsHint: Optional allowlist of relative subpaths exposed (empty = the whole root).

workspaces.deleteBody: This removes the registration only — it never touches files on the host. Sessions pointing at it will fail to launch.

browser.title: Files
browser.readOnlyWorkspace: This workspace is read-only — edits are disabled.
browser.binary: Binary file — preview not shown. Download to inspect.
browser.truncated: Read truncated at the size cap — download for the full file.
browser.pickFile: Select a file to view or edit.
browser.deleteBody: This deletes the entry from the host workspace. It cannot be undone.
browser.deleteRecursive: Delete folder and all its contents (recursive)

empty.title: No Claude Code sessions
empty.description: Create a governed session to run Claude Code from the console — no SSH. Olivares launches the process and polices every tool-call.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.description: You don’t have permission to operate Claude Code sessions.

profiles.title: Provider profiles
profiles.subtitle: The durable identity of one configured provider instance on one execution environment: which driver serves it and the configuration home a launched session runs under. A profile registers homes that already exist — it installs nothing and logs nothing in.

environment.foreignHint: This profile belongs to another execution environment. It is shown as such and is never launched from this node.

operable.noHint: Legacy enablement: the profile is not active, belongs to another environment, or its driver is not registered here. It is not a launch verdict.

empty.title: No provider profiles
empty.registerHint: Use “{{control}}” above to register the configuration home of an existing provider installation on this node; sessions then launch and are attributed under a stable identity.
empty.noWrite: Registering the configuration home of an existing provider installation needs sessions:profile:write, which your role does not include.

filteredEmpty.title: No profiles match this state
filteredEmpty.description: Only profiles in the state “{{state}}” are listed. Show all states to remove this filter.

profiles.noRead: Provider profiles are not shown: your role does not include sessions:profile:read.

create.title: Register a provider profile
create.description: Registers the homes of an existing provider installation on this execution environment. The server validates each path on this node — absolute, symlinks resolved, existing and a directory. Nothing is created, installed or logged in, and no credential is sent.
create.driverHint: Lowercase driver key (letters, digits, - _ .). Whether this node can launch the profile is reported by the server after registration; it is not decided by the name.
create.configHomeHint: Absolute path of the provider’s configuration directory (for Claude Code, its CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR). Validated on this node; a missing directory is refused, never created.
create.userHomeHint: Absolute path the launched session runs under as HOME. Validated on this node.
create.environmentKnown: Registered on this node’s execution environment {{env}}, which validates the paths. A profile for another environment is registered from that environment.
create.environmentUnknown: Registered on this node’s execution environment, which validates the paths. A profile for another environment is registered from that environment.

rename.title: Rename profile
rename.description: The label may change; the identity — driver, environment and homes — does not.
rename.label: Display name

disable.hint: A disabled profile refuses new launches, resumes and bindings; a session it already governs keeps running. Reversible.

retire.title: Retire profile
retire.description: Retirement is irreversible: this profile id accepts nothing afterwards — not even a rename — and its history stays as it was. The home becomes free for a new profile id.

details.loadFailed: This profile could not be read.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.hint: The stored homes are an admin-only read, fetched only when you ask and never shown in the list. No credential value is ever returned.
configuration.validatedOn: Paths as validated and stored by execution environment {{env}}.
configuration.failed: The configuration could not be read.

bindings.title: Source bindings
bindings.subtitle: Dedicates one configured source, at the exact revision this node applied, to one profile, so the sessions that source observes are attributed to it. The identity is the source’s persistent id and revision — never its name.

empty.title: No source bindings
empty.description: Bind a configured source to a profile to attribute the sessions it observes.

bindings.noRead: Source bindings are not shown: your role does not include sessions:profile-binding:read.
bindings.notBindable: Only an active profile of this execution environment can take a binding.

revoke.title: Revoke binding
revoke.description: Sessions already attributed under this binding keep their provenance; later observations through this source are no longer attributed to the profile. This cannot be undone — a new binding is a new row.

create.title: Bind a source to a profile
create.description: The engine binds the source’s persistent id at the revision this node applied. Both are read from the source roster — never typed, never derived from a name.
create.profileHint: Only an active profile of this execution environment can take a binding.
create.profilesNotRead: Profiles could not be read, so none can be selected.
create.sourceHint: Sources of the deployment roster, with the revision this node applied. A source this node has not applied cannot be bound here.
create.needsSourceAdmin: Binding a source also requires deployment-wide source administration (system admin). Your account cannot read the source roster, so no source can be selected here.
create.rosterFailed: The source roster could not be read.
create.rosterEmpty: No sources are configured on this deployment.

details.title: Binding details
details.description: Current binding details for the selected tenant. Refresh to check for changes.
details.loading: Reading the binding from the engine…
details.forbidden: The engine refused this binding to your account just now (sessions:profile-binding:read on the active tenant); the engine decided this now, not a cached answer. Nothing of it is shown.
details.missing: The engine holds no binding with this reference for the active tenant right now. It may have been removed since the list was read; refresh the list to see the current rows.
details.error: The binding could not be read: {{message}}
details.ended: The read ended because your permission, tenant or session changed. Open Details again to read under the current authority.

view.crossHint: Profiles and bindings also have their own pages, each entered with its own read permission.

authority.lost: This action is no longer permitted with your current permissions; nothing was sent.
authority.confirmationClosed: The confirmation was closed because the permission it needed is gone.

roster.forbidden: The deployment refused the source roster to your account, so no source can be bound from here. Binding needs deployment-wide source administration in addition to profile-binding write; the engine decided this just now, not a cached answer.
roster.error: The source roster could not be read: {{message}}
roster.ended: The roster read ended because your permission, tenant or session changed. Open Bind again to read it under the current authority.
roster.loadedProfiles: Loaded {{n}} active profiles; there are more.

code.credential_source_not_injected: This combination does not inject an inference credential.

code.runtime_credentials_not_requested: This composition does not request work/K3 runtime credentials.

code.runtime_readiness_unavailable: Work/K3 runtime readiness could not be observed.
